site_name: Target, 18195 Waco St NW, Elk River
serving_utility: Elk River Municipal Utilities (City of Elk River)
utility_evidence_kind: local map with a utility page
utility_evidence_period: the state's layer as edited 26 November 2025; the utility's page as read 2026-11-15
notes: Verification pass, session 9, round 2 (D-58 rule 3, D-59 item 2). The State of Minnesota's electric utility service areas layer, queried by the session at the site's coordinates, returns one area: full_name 'Elk River Municipal Utilities', mpuc_name 'Elk River Municipal Utilities', eia_utility_id 5773. The utility's own page (ermumn.com/about-us): 'ERMU serves more than 13,600 electric customers in Elk River and the surrounding area.' Accepted at medium under D-48's rule for a map read at the coordinates with a page of the named utility; in Minnesota service areas are assigned to one utility. The city is also served in part by Connexus Energy, which is why a list of cities would not have done.

site_name: State Farm (now DigiCo), 24400 W Valley Pkwy, Olathe
serving_utility: Evergy Kansas Metro (Evergy Metro, formerly Kansas City Power & Light)
utility_evidence_kind: local map with a utility page
utility_evidence_period: the regulator's certificate of 14 December 1978 (later amendments not seen) and the city's layer as modified July 2021
notes: Verification pass, session 9, round 2 (D-58 rule 3, D-59 item 2). Two records, both opened by the session. The Kansas Corporation Commission's certificate for Johnson County (docket 117,213-U) lists under KANSAS CITY POWER & LIGHT COMPANY, for T-13-S, R-23-E, 'Secs. 9 thru 12'; the federal land survey puts the site in T13S R23E, section 9; the section is not on The Kansas Power and Light Company's list in the same order. The City of Olathe's 'Electric Service Areas' layer at the site's coordinates returns ProviderName 'Evergy, Kansas Metro' (https://arcgis.olatheks.org/arcgis/rest/services/EnerGov/EnerGov_display_map/FeatureServer/39/query?geometry=-94.86766,38.93951&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&f=json). Kansas City Power & Light became Evergy Metro. This MOVES the site off the Kansas City, Kansas Board of Public Utilities, where the smallest-territory rule had put it. Against it, filed: a 2025 commission hearing notice names Olathe among towns Evergy Kansas Central serves, at the level of the city; Olathe is divided between the two Evergy companies, and the section-level certificate and the city's own layer govern for this address. The neighbouring site bi:615-0 (23800 W Valley Pkwy) was not looked at in this pass.

site_name: NSA Utah Data Center, Camp Williams, Bluffdale
utility_evidence_period: 20 May 2013 (a law signed 1 April 2013); the 2009 report speaks of plans
notes: Verification pass, session 9, round 2 (D-58 rule 3, D-59 item 2). The Salt Lake Tribune, on its own archive: the law 'allows the entity ... to collect a tax of up to 6 percent on Rocky Mountain Power electricity used by the Utah Data Center', and the authority 'asked lawmakers for permission to tax up to 6 of the energy Rocky Mountain Power sells the Utah Data Center', attributed to the authority's testimony to a Senate committee. KSL, 2009: 'Rocky Mountain Power says it's going to take a lot of work and planning to accommodate the center's needs, including new power lines and a substation.' This replaces the earlier verification, whose page names no utility. Against it, filed: the state's service-area layer returns Lehi City Power at the inventory's coordinates, which the record hunt found to be a lot in a subdivision and not the center; a named statement governs over a map reading at a doubtful point (D-48), and the site is flagged for its coordinates.

site_name: eBay Topaz data center, 6614 West Crimson View Drive, South Jordan
utility_evidence_period: 26 November 2012; the city's page as read 2026-11-15
notes: Reclassed in session 10 (D-61 section 3). Utility power on a fire pump is an auxiliary connection; the assignment rests on the city's listing, checked against the state's two layers at the parcel (pass_c_layer_conditions.csv). It covers what is delivered at the address. The operator's second phase ran its IT load on on-site fuel cells from September 2013 with the grid as backup (trade press of 2012 and 2013, in the log), so the row has an open capacity question. Verification pass, session 9, round 2 (D-58 rule 3, D-59 item 2). A Utah Division of Air Quality compliance memorandum for 'EBAY INC. - TOPAZ (SOUTH JORDAN) DATA CENTER' records the company's corrective action: the fire pump engine's 'weekly test performed using Rocky Mountain Power, instead of using the backup generator'. A government document about the site that names the utility whose power it runs on. The City of South Jordan's own page (sjc.utah.gov/345/Moving-to-South-Jordan) lists 'Electricity : Rocky Mountain Power'. The same memorandum: 'Construction of the facility was completed in May of 2010'.
